# Procedural Baseline Autogenerated Bundle — 2026-09-14

## Status

This bundle is a **development-only procedural baseline** generated with Babylon.js `NullEngine` and exported as valid glTF 2.0 binary assets. It is suitable for local preview, loader integration, and automated file-integrity checks. It is **not** a high-fidelity art delivery and must not promote any asset to `verified` or `readyForRuntime`.

| GLB validation | 8/8 valid: magic `glTF`, version 2, declared length matches file length |

## Explicit Limitations

The bundle does not provide artist-authored topology, PBR texture sets, UV quality, production skeletons, animation clips, LOD authoring, collision approval, or device performance evidence. The existing asset manifest must continue to keep real `glbUrl` values null and status `pending-import`. The bundle therefore cannot clear the high-fidelity asset gate, real-device performance gate, or account-side security gate.

## Reproduction

```bash
BASELINE_ASSET_OUTPUT=/home/ubuntu/webdev-static-assets/ice-snow-city/procedural-baseline-autogenerated-2026-09-14 \
  node scripts/generateProceduralBaselineGlb.mjs

BASELINE_ASSET_OUTPUT=/home/ubuntu/webdev-static-assets/ice-snow-city/procedural-baseline-autogenerated-2026-09-14 \
  node scripts/validateProceduralBaseline.mjs
```

The validation command must report `valid=8` and `invalid=0`. Any future attempt to mark these files as high-fidelity must fail review unless the real asset delivery manifest and its required evidence are supplied separately.
